description: Updates various attributes of an existing Trello organization, identified by `idOrg`.

desc.description: New description for the organization (0-16384 characters).
desc.title: Desc

displayName.description: New display name for the organization (length of at least 1, cannot begin or end with a space).
displayName.title: Display Name

idOrg.description: The ID or name of the organization to update.
idOrg.title: Id Org

name.description: New name for the organization (0-16384 characters); typically lowercase, without spaces.
name.title: Name

prefs__associatedDomain.description: The Google Workspace domain to associate with the organization (e.g., 'example.com'). Clears the domain if an empty string is provided.
prefs__associatedDomain.title: Prefs  Associated Domain

prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__org.description: Controls who can create organization-visible boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).
prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__org.title: Prefs  Board Visibility Restrict  Org

prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__private.description: Controls who can create private boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).
prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__private.title: Prefs  Board Visibility Restrict  Private

prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__public.description: Controls who can create public boards. Valid values: 'admin' (only admins), 'org' (any organization member), 'none' (disabled).
prefs__boardVisibilityRestrict__public.title: Prefs  Board Visibility Restrict  Public

prefs__externalMembersDisabled.description: Set to 'true' to prevent external members (guests) from being added to boards within the organization. Set to 'false' to allow external members.
prefs__externalMembersDisabled.title: Prefs  External Members Disabled

prefs__googleAppsVersion.description: The version of Google Workspace integration. Valid values are '1' or '2'.
prefs__googleAppsVersion.title: Prefs  Google Apps Version

prefs__orgInviteRestrict.description: Restricts organization membership invitations to email addresses from specified domains. Use a comma-separated list of domains (e.g., 'example.com,*.example.org'). An empty string removes restrictions.
prefs__orgInviteRestrict.title: Prefs  Org Invite Restrict

prefs__permissionLevel.description: Sets the default permission level for new boards created in the organization. Valid values: 'private' or 'public'.
prefs__permissionLevel.title: Prefs  Permission Level

website.description: The organization's website URL. Must start with 'http://' or 'https://'. Use the literal string 'null' or an empty string to remove the website.
website.title: Website

name: update_organizations_by_id_org

OrganizationPrefs.description: Organization preferences including board visibility restrictions, permission levels, and attachment restrictions
OrganizationPrefs.title: OrganizationPrefs

billableMemberCount.description: The number of billable members in the organization
billableMemberCount.title: Billable Member Count

dateLastActivity.description: The timestamp of the last activity in the organization in ISO 8601 format
dateLastActivity.title: Date Last Activity

descData.description: The description data for the organization
descData.title: Desc Data

displayName.description: The display name for the organization. Must be a string with a length from 1 to 16384
displayName.title: Display Name

id.description: The unique identifier for the organization
id.title: Id

idBoards.description: Array of board IDs that belong to the organization
idBoards.title: Id Boards

idEnterprise.description: The ID of the enterprise the organization belongs to, if applicable
idEnterprise.title: Id Enterprise

invitations.description: Array of pending invitations to the organization
invitations.title: Invitations

invited.description: Whether the organization has invited members
invited.title: Invited

logoHash.description: The logo hash for the organization's logo
logoHash.title: Logo Hash

memberships.description: Array of membership objects representing organization members
memberships.title: Memberships

name.description: The name of the organization. Must be a string of 3 to 100 lowercase alphanumeric characters, underscores, or hyphens
name.title: Name

offering.description: The offering type for the organization (e.g., 'trello.enterprise')
offering.title: Offering

powerUps.description: Array of power-ups available to the organization
powerUps.title: Power Ups

prefs.description: Organization preferences including board visibility restrictions, permission levels, and attachment restrictions
prefs.title: Prefs

premiumFeatures.description: Array of premium features available to the organization
premiumFeatures.title: Premium Features

products.description: Array of products associated with the organization
products.title: Products

url.description: The URL to the organization workspace
url.title: Url

website.description: The website URL of the organization
website.title: Website
